summary: Master credit control and debt management with our comprehensive training course. Equip yourself with essential tools to boost your financial expertise.
lede: Credit control combines customer risk assessment with practical methods for managing overdue invoices. Finance, credit and collections professionals practise reviewing creditworthiness, interpreting ageing reports, setting collection escalations and resolving disputes. They also learn to track payment plans and receivables performance, then prepare action reports for finance and commercial decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage credit exposure, overdue invoices, collections follow-up, and receivables performance in real operating environments.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of invoicing, customer accounts, and basic finance terminology. No programming is required, and the course is suitable for foundation to intermediate professionals who already handle credit approvals, collections follow-up, accounts receivable monitoring, or related reporting. Familiarity with spreadsheets such as Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets is helpful for ageing analysis and collections tracking, but not mandatory.
